findings.title: Consent store load-modify-save without lock
findings.problem: connect-folder and disconnect-folder load, modify and save the store with no lock; concurrent runs overwrite each other.
findings.impact: A concurrent connect can overwrite a disconnect, leaving revoked consent in place (admin-visible uploads). Reachability unconfirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: Serialize load-modify-save with a lock file or atomic compare-and-replace.
findings.check_notes: withStoreLock (pid lock, wait 10s) wraps connect and disconnect; concurrency test added.

fix.change: confirmed defect: connectFolder/disconnectFolder load-modify-save now run under a pid-lock (consent-store.ts withStoreLock)

findings.title: Subfolder disconnect is a no-op under parent consent
findings.problem: disconnectFolder removes only entries equal to the given folder; disconnecting a subfolder of a connected parent reports 'Nothing to change' while the parent consent still covers it.
findings.impact: User believes consent is revoked while the subfolder keeps publishing to work scope. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Refuse with an explicit message naming the covering parent entry, or record an exclusion for the subfolder.
findings.check_notes: coveringEntries + disconnect command names covering parent and exact command; tests added.

fix.change: confirmed defect: disconnect-folder prints the effective covering parent connection and the exact disconnect command (coveringEntries), also after its own entry was removed

findings.title: takeNotice can overwrite a concurrent stop
findings.problem: takeNotice reads a notice-only marker and atomicReplaces {...m, noticed:true} with no lock; if the daemon upgrades the marker to stop:true in between, the stale stop:false copy is written back.
findings.impact: A persisted publication stop is silently downgraded and the session publishes again (fail-open, privacy boundary).
findings.recommendation: Re-read and compare under the same lock before replacing, or hold noticed in a separate sidecar file.
findings.check_notes: takeNotice and upgradeToStop serialized on a marker lock; monotonic tests added.

fix.change: confirmed defect: takeNotice and the notice->stop upgrade serialize on a per-marker lock so a stop is never downgraded

findings.title: folder_changed compare ignores project source and case
findings.problem: transitionGate compares resolveProjectAtCwd(cwd) !== record.project, case-sensitive and with env then config order only, ignoring record.project_source (env pin, linked folder); consent compare is case-insensitive. connectWorkFolder also resolves via loadHookConfig which prefers CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.
findings.impact: Healthy pinned/linked-folder sessions can be permanently stopped as folder_changed, or the user is asked to confirm a wrong project. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Compare with the same source order as resolveSessionProject, skip when project_source differs, normalize trim and case.
findings.check_notes: trim/lowercase comparison in transitionGate; test added.

fix.change: confirmed for case/trim only: transitionGate compares project trimmed and case-insensitively; source order left unchanged (check never skipped; no source mismatch reproduced)

findings.title: transitionGate continues when identity unavailable
findings.problem: transitionGate returns 'continue' when currentEvidenceIdentity() is null before checking the stop marker or the resume rule; non-existing/created record kinds return bare 'stop' with no marker or notice.
findings.impact: A stopped or unrecorded resumed session keeps spooling while credentials are unreadable; capacity stops are silent. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed when identity is null for a new-contract session and write a marker/notice for the bare-stop paths.
findings.check_notes: Rejection plausible: daemon tick keys on endpoint identity and sends nothing without it; no code change.

fix.change: rejected/limitation: no identity => no stop-marker key, nothing is sent (forwarder evidenceContext returns null without identity, events park in pending-owner); bare stop for unavailable/capacity records retries on the next hook; unchanged

findings.title: connect-folder/disconnect-folder actions untested
findings.problem: Only subcommand registration is asserted; no test invokes the actions (confirmation gate, --yes/non-TTY, Copilot guard, identity requirement, store mutation).
findings.impact: A regression skipping confirmation authorizes admin-visible conversation content with no failing test.
findings.recommendation: Add command-level tests: --yes connects, non-TTY without --yes exits 1 with no entry, Copilot refusal, disconnect removes.

fix.change: evidence gap closed: command-level tests for connect/disconnect actions

findings.title: Consent header dropped for non-Latin1 project
findings.problem: rawProjectHeader returns nothing for non-Latin1 project names, so the project header is omitted while ctx.consent is true.
findings.impact: Echo check fails and the session is stopped as response_unverified for a legitimate project. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Encode the project per the wire contract or refuse to send and report consent_without_project locally.
findings.check_notes: buildAttributionHeaders omits consent with project; test asserts; echo check then fails closed.

fix.change: rejected/limitation: non-Latin1 projects are an existing shared wire limit; confirmed fail-closed (no project and no consent header, echo mismatch stops the session); no new encoding

findings.title: No security-review sign-off for attribution headers
findings.problem: security-practices.md marks adding X-CodeMie-* attribution headers (contract, funding route, consent) as CRITICAL needing recorded sign-off; none is recorded.
findings.impact: Documented workflow gate unmet; PR would merge a CRITICAL change without required review.
findings.recommendation: Call the change out as CRITICAL in the PR description and record security-review sign-off.
findings.check_notes: Mapped tests are not a recorded security sign-off; controller itself lists sign-off outstanding.

fix.change: evidence gap: trust-boundary tests added (model strip, OTLP ingress, forged header ignored); formal security-review sign-off for CRITICAL X-CodeMie-* headers remains outstanding before merge

disposition.rationale: Accepted locally by the user: formal security sign-off for the X-CodeMie-* headers is handled by the responsible reviewer through the eventual MR review; header attribution is flagged CRITICAL in the future MR description and the sign-off remains a requirement before merge. Not a blocker for local completion.

findings.title: Header strip and OTLP ingress tests missing
findings.problem: Spec 11a/11b require tests that stripAnalyticsOnlyHeaders runs in HeaderInjectionInterceptor.onRequest and that injected headers via the cloned-settings OTLP ingress (otlp.plugin handleRequest) never reach the backend; only the pure helper and a mocked forwarder are tested.
findings.impact: Removing or misplacing the strip call ships client-supplied consent/funding headers on model traffic with no failing test; security boundary against forged consent.
findings.recommendation: Add an onRequest interceptor test with mixed-case consent/funding/contract headers and an ingress test through otlp.plugin handleRequest asserting analytics request headers come only from the frozen record.
findings.check_notes: Mixed-case strip test on interceptor onRequest and ingress spool test added.

fix.change: evidence gap closed: onRequest mixed-case strip test and OTLP ingress (handleRequest) test

findings.title: Unconsented request accepted with project destination
findings.problem: echoVerified returns true when !ctx.consent after accepting dest 'project' or 'personal'; a request sent without consent that the backend routes to project is acknowledged as success.
findings.impact: Privacy mismatch (work-visible storage without consent) is not detected and the session keeps publishing.
findings.recommendation: if (!ctx.consent) return dest === 'personal'; add an N0 + project-destination test.
findings.check_notes: Rejection upheld: echoVerified keeps N0 routing as approved; N0+project test and derived corporate e2e pass.

fix.change: rejected: blanket !consent -> personal-only conflicts with approved N0 derived corporate/codemie routing; both routing cases now pinned
fix.test: forwarder-contract.test.ts N0 project destination acknowledged; N0 personal acknowledged (existing)

findings.title: 422 contract_unsupported stops without refresh
findings.problem: A 422 publication_contract_unsupported is an immediate final stop; spec item 2 / AC9 require one bounded capability refresh before hold/suspend. The 422 decoder also ignores the body disposition field.
findings.impact: A stale policy racing a backend change permanently stops a healthy session; required behavior not implemented.
findings.recommendation: On first contract_unsupported, refresh capability once and hold; stop only if still unsupported after refresh; consider honoring disposition.
findings.check_notes: One bounded refresh in send(); resend, hold and final cases tested.

fix.change: confirmed defect: 422 publication_contract_unsupported refreshes capability once; still advertised => one resend (second refusal final+stop); no longer advertised => hold with notice, no stop, no ack

findings.title: sendGuard skipped for non-evidence streams
findings.problem: sendGuard is evaluated only when req.evidence is set; non-evidence streams of the same stopped session skip the stop and generation checks despite the comment claiming all paths check isStopped.
findings.impact: Stopped sessions may still upload OTEL streams. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Apply isStopped/generation check to every stream of a new-contract session, or document and test why non-evidence streams are exempt.
findings.check_notes: Evidence context is built once per forwardSession and passed to all streams; stopped-session test covers hooks, OTLP and JSON.

fix.change: rejected for evidence sessions: forwardSession builds one EvidenceContext and passes it to hooks, OTLP and JSON streams; stop/generation guard applies to all; legacy (non-evidence) sessions intentionally unchanged; consumer test added
fix.test: forwarder-contract.test.ts stopped session sends on no stream

findings.title: Missing policy read as contract not advertised
findings.problem: contractAdvertised is `policy ? advertisesContract(policy) : false`; with stale credentials or no endpoint identity the backend was never consulted yet a hold notice is written and past retention a permanent hold_expired stop. Tick wiring (stopped, contractAdvertised, hold_expired, needContract) has no tick-processor test.
findings.impact: False 'backend not ready' notice and permanent stop of a healthy session; dropped inputs would go unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Pass undefined (unknown) when policy is absent and skip hold/notice; add tick-processor tests for stop marker, unadvertised policy and lose-past-retention.
findings.check_notes: Unknown capability stays held with distinct hold_state_unknown notice; tick-processor tests added.

fix.change: confirmed in part: unknown/absent capability stays held and bounded, but the notice is distinct (hold_state_unknown) from an authoritative not-advertised hold; tick wiring tests added

findings.title: AC2/AC3/AC9 cases not covered against real backend
findings.problem: No e2e for a profile-sourced project without entry, a global profile in an unrelated folder, or derived corporate N0 route; 200 final discards and 503 holds are unit-only with mocked transports.
findings.impact: Acceptance criteria that require real-backend verification are unproven.
findings.recommendation: Add the missing drive.mjs scenarios or record Stage 7 evidence covering them.
findings.check_notes: drive.mjs scenarios added; results.json present and all new checks ok.

fix.change: evidence gap closed: PG17 harness extended (profile-sourced no-consent private, derived corporate N0 project routing, real-backend 503 hold then delivery, SYNTHETIC 200 discard); 45/45 assertions, drive exit 0

findings.title: No duplicate-consumption guard across /clear and resume
findings.problem: Spec item 9 / AC8 require no duplicate consumption across a /clear pair plus resume; no change or test shows it, and the e2e step only replays the same session id.
findings.impact: Required behavior unproven; usage entries may be uploaded twice.
findings.recommendation: Implement or demonstrate the guard and add a test covering a /clear pair plus resume in the same scope.
findings.check_notes: Demonstrated by clear+repeated-resume e2e (REPLAY hooks), no duplicated usage rows; no new mechanism.

fix.change: evidence gap closed, no defect reproduced: /clear pair + 3x repeated resume/Stop of the known sessions add no usage rows and no stop; no dedup mechanism added (REPLAY hook sequence, not live TUI)
